property_summary: After calling SetMinSum(v), any subsequent Put call with any msg.value and lockTime should result in the same Acc[caller].unlockTime in both reference and mutant if the caller is different from the SetMinSum caller, but the bug mutates MinSum storage which does not affect unlockTime logic—thus we instead assert that c.MinSum() equals the argument passed to SetMinSum (the reference always holds this; the mutant increments by one, violating equality).
change_summary: Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = _val + 1;' so that the stored MinSum differs from the value passed.
